maddeler.e:
ننتزع (form VIII)
# نَنْتَزِعُ (nantaziʕu) /nan.ta.zi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# نُنْتَزَعُ (nuntazaʕu) /nun.ta.za.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# نَنْتَزِعَ (nantaziʕa) /nan.ta.zi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# نُنْتَزَعَ (nuntazaʕa) /nun.ta.za.ʕa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
